training_policy.domain_training: Generate and train on synthetic imagery from the digital twin.
training_policy.real_data: Use real imagery for inspection/evaluation; do not fit weights on it.
training_policy.disclosure: Report generic pretrained backbone data separately from synthetic CSI-domain fine-tuning. Legacy real-trained comparators are not proof of a synthetic-only solution.
training_policy.split_unit: Keep complete rendered scene/seed and its crops together. Use separate synthetic development and test scenes; preserve a fresh source-disjoint physical evaluation.

proposed_shared_observation.source_identity: session, station, camera/profile, source hash, decoded frame and native clock
proposed_shared_observation.target: fixture ID, explicit target slot, crop-to-full-image transform and source dimensions
proposed_shared_observation.visual_evidence: per-class proposal/score, unavailable reason, model/config IDs and exact image
proposed_shared_observation.occupancy_context: expected placement progress or attributed order-complete context; unknown is allowed
proposed_shared_observation.physical_association: confirmed physical vial-to-slot link with evidence and uncertainty, or explicitly unlinked

fusion_policy: Display filling and final-fixture evidence in the same operator workflow while retaining separate station assessments.
Join an earlier fill assessment to a final slot only with a confirmed physical association. Color similarity, sequential track numbers and assumed timing are insufficient.
An empty future slot is not automatically a missed placement; missing progress makes that interpretation unavailable.
A visually acceptable cap does not clear an earlier mixture concern. A recognized color does not certify intended recipe correctness.
Keep fixture labels, observed physical routing and product acceptance separate; confirm current routing semantics with CSI.
The dashboard issues advice and records human responses. It does not send line sensor/actuator commands.
candidate_experiments: Begin with one target-slot task and a bounded synthetic defect fixture. Compare raw rendered and visually reviewed appearance variations before scaling.
Evaluate a synthetic-trained lightweight crop classifier or reference-comparison model on complete held-out fixture scenes. Keep neighboring crops grouped by source scene.
Consider TAO Visual ChangeNet and Cosmos Reason as independent candidates with explicit image/reference alignment and content integrity checks; neither is integrated or validated by this proposal.
Report each defect class's misses and false alarms, confirmed-empty versus uncapped confusion, and whole-scene coverage. Choose operating settings without consuming the physical final test.

Measure performance on held-out simulation and fresh real scenes under the same target definition; quantify the gap and any reduction with identical evaluation cases and clearly separate development iterations.
